full_prompt_en: The image is a square hand-drawn collage illustration of a crowded whimsical group of animal-like characters in patterned clothing against a warm beige paper ground. The background remains mostly open at the top, where small flat cloud shapes in dark teal, pink, pale coral, and blue float across the page. A large pale round-faced creature rises near the upper center, wearing a simple yellow crown and showing small round eyes and a pink rectangular nose. On the left, a gray long-snouted figure in a mustard jacket and pink apron stands close to the edge, with a tiny dark figure near its lower pocket. Beside it, a smaller pale face with a dark tuft of hair wears a dark patterned garment. In the front middle, a pink-nosed figure in a mustard top looks outward, its round cheeks set above a low yellow platform crowded with tiny toy-like figures and floral marks. To the right, a broad smiling face in a blue patterned coat has another little yellow crown, while a dark gray long-nosed figure in brown and blue extends toward the far right edge. More miniature characters and decorative shapes fill the narrow gaps behind and between the larger forms. A dark dotted band beneath the group anchors their feet without becoming a realistic ground plane. The image combines fine drawn outlines with clipped-looking areas of dots, checks, stripes, and tiny floral prints. Colors stay slightly muted: mustard yellow, dusty pink, faded blue, charcoal, and cream recur across bodies, clothing, and background accents. Flat, even light leaves little cast shadow; depth comes instead from overlapping silhouettes, shifts in scale, and dense patterned layers. The straight-on view makes the group read like a playful paper tableau, with prominent faces arranged at several heights. The overall composition packs eccentric characters into a compact central mound while small colored clouds and pale paper keep the crowded detail from feeling heavy.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形手绘拼贴插画，一群奇趣的动物样角色穿着有花纹的衣服，拥挤地站在暖米色纸面背景前。上方背景大体空阔，深青、粉色、浅珊瑚色与蓝色的小小平面云形飘在纸页上。靠近上部中央，一只浅色圆脸生物高高升起，戴简单的黄色王冠，有小圆眼和粉色长方形鼻子。左侧，一只灰色长口鼻角色穿芥末黄外套和粉围裙，紧靠画边站立，下面的口袋附近还有一个细小的深色角色。它旁边，一张有深色额发的较小浅色面孔穿深色花纹衣服。前方中央，一只粉鼻角色穿芥末色上衣朝外看，圆脸颊下方是一块低矮的黄色平台，上面挤满微小玩具般的形体和花纹。右侧，一张宽宽的笑脸穿蓝色花纹外套，戴另一顶小黄冠；深灰色长口鼻形体穿棕蓝衣服，伸向最右画边。更多迷你角色和装饰形状填满大形体后面及彼此间的狭缝。人群脚下的深色点纹带把它们固定住，却没有成为写实地面。图像把细手绘轮廓与仿佛剪贴的圆点、格纹、条纹和细花印花结合。色彩略为低饱和，芥末黄、灰粉、旧蓝、炭灰和奶油色在身体、衣服与背景强调中反复出现。平坦均匀的光几乎不留投影，纵深来自剪影遮挡、尺度变化与密集花纹层。正面视点让角色群像像一座俏皮的纸上小舞台，显眼的面孔在不同高度排列。整体构图将古怪角色挤成中央紧凑的轮廓团，同时以彩色小云和浅纸面让繁密细节不显沉重。
style_prompt_en: Hand-drawn collage illustration layers fine outlines over a warm, lightly grained paper surface. Muted mustard, dusty pink, faded blue, charcoal, and cream appear as small repeating patches rather than smooth blended volumes. Dots, checks, stripes, and tiny floral marks sit beside plain areas, so local pattern density changes constantly across the image. Irregular cutout-like edges and flat colored shapes keep the forms playful, while selective dark contour lines make the crowded overlaps legible. Light is even and low in contrast; scale shifts and partial occlusion provide depth instead of cast shadows. Most detail gathers in a compact central cluster, leaving modest pale breathing room around the outer edges. The overall effect is intricate, whimsical, and tactile, with patterned surface and layered rhythm carrying the style.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘拼贴插画把细轮廓线叠在温暖、略带颗粒的纸面上。低饱和芥末黄、灰粉、旧蓝、炭灰与奶油色以重复的小色片出现，而非平滑混合的体积。圆点、格纹、条纹与细花记号挨着素色区域，使局部花纹密度在画面各处不断变化。不规则、近似剪纸的边缘和平面色形让形体俏皮，选定的深色轮廓线则使拥挤交叠可读。光线均匀、反差较低；尺度变化和局部遮挡代替投影提供纵深。多数细节聚在紧凑的中央区域，外缘留下少量浅色呼吸空间。整体效果繁密、奇趣且可感，花纹表面与层叠节奏承担画风。
theme_en: A crowded whimsical group of animal-like characters wearing patterned clothes and small crowns
theme_zh: 一群穿花纹衣服、戴小王冠的奇趣动物角色拥挤地站在一起
name: Ferris Plock
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
